cross_stage_feedback.rule: Any evolutionary/research candidate that mutates, fuses, forks or restarts must preserve evidence refs, measured metric, source check and lineage parentage. k245/k247 show why evidence dropped during inheritance blocks trustworthy promotion.

Activity count is not evolution. Track proposal novelty/diversity, deaths/culling, dominant-approach share, successful crystallizations and measured post-promotion value; reproduce k251-style no-selection failure as a negative baseline.
Historical/log/generated noise must be filtered or dispositioned before becoming research tasks. k248/k250 show that stale logs and warnings otherwise create self-reinforcing false work.
Visual/self-state introspection must compete with non-self/world/task channels. k243→k244 shows dedicated AURA interpretation became monopolizing enough to require alternation and slim context.
Separate bounded hot working state from immutable/history-retaining archive, with exact linkage and replay. Never satisfy latency by silently deleting identity-bearing historical state (k240).
For every network/runtime service, PASS requires functional endpoint/workload heartbeat in addition to process/service status. Reproduce k252 active-but-hung failure.
Run installation under a different username/home/temp/data root and assert no legacy absolute path remains. k254 removed 220+ machine-specific path assumptions across 72 files.
